Left alone the participant's name is written where a date belongs.

the form carries two mailing-address fields and both bind the participant's own address. Only one of them is the participant's; the second must be labelled and checked before anything is written to it.

rows.whatTheNextBuilderShouldExpect: NHJB-2328 is a 90-field statement of assets and liabilities carrying employer, income and household detail. Only one of its fields binds a fact the platform holds, so the work there is 89 classifications rather than 89 writes, and several of its blanks are a spouse's or an employer's rather than the participant's -- the class this cohort treats as a refusal on sight.
